details: Are you guys going to add a system where we can disable the full body frame drop thing you guys did? Also, to disable the information about models? Second one should be a moderator thing, not a common man thing, and the first thing ruins the game not only for full body people, but people who frequent MMD dance worlds-- like myself. The yoinking the avatar thing I could live with, even if it will probably kill Avatar worlds and it's an overall bad idea, but those two main things make me worry that this game is going in the same direction other games go when they start making changes for the worst. I've spent too much money and time on this game not to be slightly upset about these changes. Please let me know what's going on through the development teams mind, and if there are going to be any fixes or roll backs on these changes. I apologize for the long thing, but I care about this game and I've put, as I said, a lot of time and money into it. Content creators, for worlds and avatars not twitch streamers and youtubers, are what keeps this game alive and fun. Please don't start pushing them away with changes to "help the new user." New users have been, and will continue to be fine without these changes. (If that's the reasoning) As someone who started creating recently, and want to continue to create for VRChat, I beg you guys not to start fixing an unbroken system.
title: New Update
